description: Weather months ahead for an exact location, as probabilities: for each month the chance of a below-, near- or above-normal temperature and precipitation (from ECMWF's SEAS5 seasonal forecast and, in the US, NOAA CPC's official outlook, over a 35-year local climate record with the warming trend), the expected and normal highs and lows, wet and snow days; for a specific date, the likely high and low and the chance of rain, snow, a freezing night or a hot day. Also the next 6 weeks as weekly odds.

date.description: A specific date within the next 12 months, YYYY-MM-DD (a wedding, a race, a trip).

elevationFt.description: Elevation of the exact spot in feet, if known.

location.description: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a place ('Napa, CA', 'Kyoto'), or a Veabird ski resort name.

spot.description: At a ski resort: the base (default) or the summit.

start.description: First month, YYYY-MM (default this month, or the date's month).

name: long_range_outlook
title: Long-range weather outlook (months ahead)
